events.line: Josh Allen just shit all over your projection and you still almost benched him, Ilir—next time trust your QB1 instead of panic-checking mock drafts at 2 AM like a psychopath.

Rilind actually benched his faith in his own receiver and still watched him go off for nearly double his projection—that's what happens when you draft St. Brown in the third round and then spend all week second-guessing yourself like a coward.

Rinor really said "I'm starting DJ Moore" and the football gods responded with "absolutely fucking not" — negative points? That's not a performance, that's a punishment for whatever crimes you committed in your draft.
Dalton Kincaid just dropped 19 fucking points on a projection of 8.4 and Ilir's out here looking like a genius for starting him—too bad that's the only smart decision you've made all season, buddy.

Rob really said "I'm gonna start Jameson Williams" and watched him put up 4.3 points like it was a fucking surprise—maybe next time don't get cute and actually check the injury report before locking in your lineup.
LaPorta went off for 14.2 and Rinor actually had the balls to start him—maybe that's the only good decision this guy's made all season, but I'll take the W for him.
